mechanical_results.packet_local_evidence_ids: required for selections, conclusions, proposition support and factual requirement support
mechanical_results.strong_proposition_scope_and_time: requires cited evidence and resolved scope/time
mechanical_results.strong_conclusion: requires every proposition and every factual requirement supported; exact non-inference requirements may instead be qualified guarded states
mechanical_results.scope_basis: model assertion retained for adjudication; no categorical Python semantic inference

counterexamples: a cited bounded proposition with beneficiary_category scope basis remains representable in an insufficient overall result
an unresolved proposition cannot produce a supported overall conclusion
a guarded state on any non-non-inference requirement fails closed
a supported factual requirement without an evidence ID fails closed
an advertised opportunity with unresolved time remains partial and cannot become supported
a historical expenditure or general purpose statement leaves exact future/rule requirements unresolved
